features.name: credit_amount_per_month
features.description: Calculates the monthly principal amount by dividing credit_amount by duration.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous rate feature that helps the linear SVM establish a margin based on monthly financial burden.

features.name: log_credit_amount
features.description: Applies a log1p transformation to the credit amount to reduce skewness.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooths the distribution of large credit amounts, allowing the linear SVM to fit a more robust hyperplane without being dominated by extreme values.

features.name: age_normalized
features.description: Min-max normalization of age to a 0-1 scale based on training set bounds.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ensures the age feature is on a similar scale to other normalized features, preventing it from disproportionately influencing the SVM margin.

features.name: financial_stability_score
features.description: Semantic judgment assessing overall financial stability based on checking_status, savings_status, and employment.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a monotonic, continuous severity measure that linearly separates financially secure applicants from vulnerable ones.

features.name: installment_burden
features.description: Normalizes the installment_commitment to a 0-1 scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a scaled linear projection of the applicant's commitment burden, suitable for linear margin optimization.

features.name: credit_history_risk
features.description: Semantic judgment evaluating the risk associated with the applicant's credit_history and existing_credits.
features.expected_model_benefit: Translates categorical risk profiles into a continuous score, enabling the SVM to assign a linear weight to historical credit behavior.

features.name: duration_normalized
features.description: Min-max normalization of the loan duration to a 0-1 scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Scales the temporal aspect of the loan, allowing the linear model to weigh duration equally against other normalized financial metrics.

features.name: property_and_housing_score
features.description: Semantic judgment of asset wealth based on property_magnitude and housing.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous composite of asset ownership, which serves as a strong linear predictor for financial capacity.

features.name: amount_per_dependent
features.description: Calculates the credit amount distributed per dependent.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a ratio feature that adjusts the requested amount by household size, offering a more nuanced linear feature for the SVM.

features.name: employment_stability_score
features.description: Semantic judgment of job security based on employment duration and job type.
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts categorical employment data into a smooth, continuous measure of income stability for linear separation.

features.name: age_duration_interaction
features.description: Multiplicative interaction between normalized age and normalized duration.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the non-linear relationship between age and loan length as a single continuous feature, allowing the linear SVM to utilize this interaction.

features.name: social_support_score
features.description: Semantic judgment of the applicant's social safety net based on personal_status, other_parties, and num_dependents.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates social and demographic factors into a single continuous score, simplifying the feature space for the linear margin.
